fallback.title: Something went wrong
fallback.description: The app hit an unexpected problem. Your account data is still protected.
fallback.cardDescription: Retry this screen, or return to the start and continue from a stable place.

offline.banner: You're offline - changes can't be saved right now

preferencesUnavailable.title: We can't open the app just yet
preferencesUnavailable.description: The app needs your account settings before it can continue, and they didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
preferencesUnavailable.loadingDescription: The app is reading your account settings. This usually takes a moment.
preferencesUnavailable.offlineDescription: The app needs your account settings before it can continue, and it can't reach them without a connection. It will carry on as soon as you're back online.
preferencesUnavailable.supportTitle: If you need support right now
preferencesUnavailable.supportBody: Crisis guidance opens without an account, whether or not the rest of the app does.

saveFailed.title: Couldn't save
saveFailed.description: Your changes are still on this screen. Check your connection and try again.
